identification.summary: Ruza Flood is Microsoft's name for a Russia-based influence-operations actor [S11]. Microsoft equates it with the operation widely known as Doppelganger [S1][S2]. Microsoft named it as one of three Russian influence actors whose 2024 US election activity shifted in synchronized fashion toward undermining the Harris-Walz campaign [S1][S3]. Public reporting on Doppelganger describes a network that clones or spoofs legitimate news websites and amplifies the content through fake social media accounts and ads [S5][S7][S8].
identification.firstObserved: Doppelganger was publicly exposed by EU DisinfoLab and Qurium in September 2022, which reported activity in Europe since at least May 2022 [S7][S8]. Microsoft reporting (seen only through search summaries) says two Ruza Flood covert propaganda outlets were created within two weeks of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine [S2][S4].
identification.notes: Microsoft name: Ruza Flood. The 'Flood' family name denotes influence operations in Microsoft's taxonomy, and Microsoft categorizes Ruza Flood under Russia, influence operations [S11]. Microsoft writes 'Ruza Flood (Doppelganger)' [S1][S2]. Keep it separate from other Microsoft-tracked Russian influence actors named alongside it: Storm-1516, Storm-1679 and Volga Flood (formerly Storm-1841, Rybar) [S1][S3]. Third-party researchers (Alethea) tie some Doppelganger-related networks to Storm-1679; that overlap is not Microsoft's statement and is not merged here (see gaps). Most technical and organizational detail about Doppelganger comes from US government, EU and researcher reporting that uses the name Doppelganger, not Ruza Flood. Treat the mapping between the two names as Microsoft's [S1][S2].

attribution.sponsor: Russian state. The US Department of Justice alleged in September 2024 that Doppelganger was run by the Russian companies Social Design Agency (SDA) and Structura National Technology, together with ANO Dialog, under the direction of the Russian Presidential Administration. DOJ named First Deputy Chief of Staff Sergei Kiriyenko as directing the effort [S5][S6]. Microsoft identifies ANO Dialog as one of the Russian organizations behind Ruza Flood [S1][S2].
attribution.confidence: Microsoft links Ruza Flood to ANO Dialog and, by citing DOJ disclosures, to backing from the Russian Presidential Administration [S1][S2][S4]. The US government's attribution of Doppelganger to SDA, Structura and ANO Dialog appears in a DOJ seizure affidavit, which is an allegation, and is backed by Treasury sanctions [S5][S6]. The German Foreign Office called Doppelganger a Kremlin-backed operation in February 2025 [S9]. None of these sources gives a formal confidence level for the Ruza Flood name itself.
attribution.basis: Microsoft Threat Analysis Center reporting [S1][S2][S4]; DOJ domain-seizure affidavit and press release, plus Treasury designations in March and September 2024 [S5][S6]; EU DisinfoLab/Qurium technical exposure [S7]; Meta platform takedown as reported by AFP [S8]; German Foreign Office reporting on the 2025 Bundestag election [S9]; a Swedish Psychological Defence Agency study of leaked SDA documents [S10].

objectives: Reduce international support for Ukraine and influence voters in the US and Europe, including in the 2024 US presidential election, as alleged by DOJ [S5][S6]. Microsoft reports that Ruza Flood amplified pro-Kremlin narratives and in 2024 shifted toward denigrating the Democratic candidate [S1][S2]. The aim reported in Germany was to erode trust in Western institutions [S9].

sectors: Voters and the general public in democratic states [S1][S5]
News media brands, which are impersonated or spoofed [S7][S8]
Political campaigns and candidates (2024 Harris-Walz campaign) [S1][S3]
regions: France, Italy, United Kingdom and Ukraine (impersonated outlets) [S8]
targeting.notes: Impersonated brands reported in 2022 included The Guardian, Der Spiegel, Bild and ANSA, among more than 60 sites that Meta said impersonated news organizations [S8]. The US targeting focus comes from DOJ and Microsoft 2024 reporting [S1][S5]. German targeting is documented from 2022 through the February 2025 Bundestag election [S7][S9].

capabilities.summary: Cybersquatted and typosquatted domains that imitate legitimate news outlets, which DOJ said violated US money-laundering and criminal trademark laws [S5][S6]. Fake social media accounts posing as US or other non-Russian users, paid social media ads, influencers and AI-generated content used to drive traffic to those domains [S6]. Spoofed articles and videos falsely attributed to real media brands [S7][S8]. Before the 2025 German election, a network of more than 100 pseudo-news sites that accumulated content for months, plus sleeper bot accounts on X [S9]. Infrastructure resilience: after the September 2024 US seizure of 32 domains, Microsoft observed the actor moving its outlets to new domains [S2][S3]. Reporting indicates use of European hosting and service companies for infrastructure [S12]. The Swedish Psychological Defence Agency, using more than 3,000 leaked SDA documents, assessed that the operation's impact has often been overestimated [S10].

campaigns.name: Doppelganger media-spoofing network (Europe)
campaigns.summary: Russia-based network cloned European news outlets (mainly German) to spread pro-Kremlin, anti-Ukraine-support narratives; active since at least May 2022 according to EU DisinfoLab/Qurium.

campaigns.name: EU DisinfoLab/Qurium exposure and Meta takedown
campaigns.summary: EU DisinfoLab and Qurium published the Doppelganger report on 27 September 2022. AFP reported that Meta removed the network, which used more than 60 sites impersonating outlets in Germany, the UK, France, Italy and Ukraine.

campaigns.name: US Treasury designations of Doppelganger actors
campaigns.summary: Treasury designated Doppelganger-linked actors (SDA and Structura leadership) in March 2024, an action DOJ coverage cited as preceding the September 2024 measures.

campaigns.name: DOJ seizure of 32 Doppelganger domains
campaigns.summary: DOJ seized 32 domains, alleging that SDA, Structura and ANO Dialog ran them under the Presidential Administration to reduce support for Ukraine and influence the 2024 US election. Treasury designated 10 individuals and two entities at the same time.

campaigns.name: 2024 US election: synchronized shift against the Harris-Walz campaign
campaigns.summary: Microsoft reported that Ruza Flood, Storm-1516 and Storm-1679 shifted toward undermining Vice President Harris's campaign, and that Ruza Flood moved outlets to new domains after the US seizures.

campaigns.name: German Bundestag election influence activity
campaigns.summary: The German Foreign Office named Doppelganger as central to a surge of bot-driven disinformation on X before the 23 February 2025 vote, involving more than 100 pseudo-news sites (reporting a government document seen by POLITICO).

diamond.adversary: Russian state-directed influence apparatus. Microsoft ties Ruza Flood to ANO Dialog [S1][S2]. DOJ alleges that SDA (Ilya Gambashidze), Structura and ANO Dialog acted under the Presidential Administration, with Sergei Kiriyenko directing [S5][S6].
diamond.capability: Spoofed news sites and articles, fake personas, paid ads, influencers, AI-generated content, and sleeper bot networks [S6][S7][S9].
diamond.infrastructure: Cybersquatted lookalike domains, more than 60 in 2022 and 32 seized in 2024 [S5][S8]. More than 100 pseudo-news sites in 2025 [S9]. Rapid migration to new domains after seizures [S2][S3]. Reported use of EU-based service providers [S12].
diamond.victim: US and European publics and voters; impersonated media brands such as The Guardian, Der Spiegel, Bild and ANSA; the 2024 Harris-Walz campaign [S1][S8].
diamond.socioPolitical: Undermining Western support for Ukraine and shaping election outcomes in the US and Germany in line with Kremlin interests [S1][S5][S9].
diamond.technology: Web hosting and domain registration, social media platforms (Facebook, X), advertising systems and generative AI tools [S6][S8][S9].

gaps: Microsoft's MTAC Election Report 4 (2024-09-17) and Report 5 PDFs could not be opened (host unreachable). Claims attributed to them (ANO Dialog link, domain migration, covert outlets created within two weeks of the invasion, Presidential Administration backing) come from search-result summaries, and which report contains each claim is not confirmed.
The exact publication date of MTAC Election Report 5 was not seen in a source; it is listed as 2024-10.
The DOJ press release and affidavit (justice.gov) and Treasury press releases could not be opened; they are cited through secondary reporting.
Microsoft has not published a full technical profile or a first-observed date for Ruza Flood. firstObserved relies on third-party Doppelganger reporting.

Whether Microsoft's Ruza Flood boundary covers every activity others label Doppelganger (SDA, Structura, bot networks, ads) is unverified. Alethea links some Doppelganger-related networks to Microsoft's Storm-1679, but Microsoft treats Storm-1679 as a separate actor.
No Microsoft reporting on Ruza Flood after 2024 was found. 2025 German election activity is attributed to 'Doppelganger' by the German Foreign Office, not by Microsoft under the Ruza Flood name.
Meta's original 2022 takedown report and the NATO StratCom COE 'Doppelganger Case' report were not opened.
No MITRE ATT&CK group entry exists for this actor; influence-operation TTPs map poorly to ATT&CK.
Measured effectiveness is contested. The Swedish Psychological Defence Agency study says impact has been overestimated [S10].

implications.jipoe: Analyst assessment derived from cited sources; validate before use. Step 1 (operational environment): the relevant cyberspace terrain is the information layer: news-media brands, social platforms (Facebook, X), ad systems, and the domain-registration and hosting providers that Doppelganger relies on, including EU-based ones [S8][S9][S12]. Step 2 (effects): the actor needs only cheap lookalike domains and sock-puppet accounts, so takedowns degrade it only briefly; it moved outlets to new domains within days of the 2024 seizures [S2][S3]. Step 3 (adversary model): a state-directed contractor ecosystem (SDA, Structura, ANO Dialog) under the Presidential Administration, according to DOJ allegations [S5][S6]. It runs persistent spoofing, bot amplification and AI content, with narratives timed to elections and to Ukraine-support debates [S1][S9]. Step 4: the MLCOA is continued spoofing of Western outlets and pre-seeded pseudo-news sites, activated around elections and NATO or Ukraine aid decisions [S1][S9]. The MDCOA is coordinated, synchronized activity with other Russian actors (Storm-1516, Storm-1679) to inject fabricated content, such as forged videos, into a crisis or election in a partner nation where US forces are based [S1][S3]. Candidate indicators: newly registered typosquats of major news brands; bursts of new or dormant accounts on X sharing the same links; paid ads pointing to cloned outlets; reappearance of seized outlets on new domains [S2][S6][S7][S9].
implications.jcc2: Analyst assessment derived from cited sources; validate before use. Situational awareness: track government and Microsoft public reporting, and track lookalike domains of host-nation media where forces are stationed, especially in Germany, where Doppelganger has repeatedly been active [S7][S9]. Authorities: the counter-actions seen so far are law-enforcement seizures, Treasury sanctions and platform takedowns [S5][S6][S8]. Military cyber elements would mainly support these through intelligence sharing and coordination, not direct action, subject to legal review. Mission assurance: the risk is to trust in information, such as spoofed news about deployments, energy or alliance cohesion, rather than to DODIN integrity; public affairs and information operations staff should pre-plan rapid attribution and correction [S7][S9]. Coordination: work with interagency partners (DOJ/FBI, Treasury, State), allied governments (for example the German Foreign Office early-warning effort with France and Poland), and platform and threat-intelligence providers, which publish under different names (Ruza Flood versus Doppelganger) [S1][S9].
